description.value: Sally's Homemade Ice Cream is a confectionery and ice cream shop tucked into a unit on 2nd Avenue in Richmond, BC. The 'homemade' branding suggests house-made ice cream products rather than a national franchise. It would make a sweet mid-ride treat stop for cyclists exploring the cycling-friendly streets and dyke trails of the Richmond area.
